name: Intercom
task: A help desk, tickets or a shared inbox
summary: Customer service platform that combines a helpdesk and shared inbox with the Fin AI agent, priced per seat plus a fee per resolved conversation.
best_for: support teams that want a messenger, shared inbox and an AI agent in one platform, and are fine paying per seat plus per resolved conversation
skip_if: you want one flat monthly price, you have a very small inbox and no need for an AI agent, or you want a tool we have tested through a paid plan ourselves
honest_knock: The bill has two meters: a price per seat and $0.99 for each conversation Fin resolves, so it grows with both team size and volume. Advanced and Expert cost $85 and $132 a seat. The cheaper Essential price is shown as a new-customer offer. We have not paid for a plan, so real-world Fin accuracy is unknown to us.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-17 on intercom.com/pricing, US dollars per seat per month, annual/monthly toggle not recorded) Essential $29 (new customers $19, 35% off), Advanced $85, Expert $132; every plan includes the Fin AI Agent, charged at $0.99 per outcome. Fin alone for an existing helpdesk: $0.99 per outcome, no seats, minimum monthly commitment. Early Stage programme: 96% off for startups under $10M raised with 15 employees or fewer. Free trial on Essential and Advanced. We have not paid for a plan.

schema_offer.description: Essential, per seat per month; Advanced $85 and Expert $132 per seat per month; Fin AI Agent $0.99 per outcome on top; new customers see $19 on Essential. Read on the vendor's own pricing page on 2026-11-17.

compare_with.name: Zendesk
compare_with.why: Zendesk is built around tickets and a long list of add-ons, while Intercom bundles its Fin AI agent into every plan and bills it per outcome. Compare per-seat cost against how many conversations Fin would resolve.
